newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Steady gains keep Nigerian share index up.
newsitem.headline: Steady gains keep Nigerian share index up.

text.p: Shares rose steadily on Thursday on the Nigerian stock market amid growing interest in quoted securities, dealers said.
The all-share index rose 7263.28 from 7247.02 on Wednesday.
"More and more investors seem to be showing interest in shares these days," said one dealer, adding "Low-priced equities are mostly to benefit from the trend."
Besides the usually active oil, food, banking and conglomerate shares, insurance as well as industrial and domestic products sectors saw increasing action on Thursday.
Dealers said improved profit profiles of the industrials accounted for a demand for Industrial Gases and Vitafoam stock.
While the gas firms rose 10 kobo to 12.80 naira, the foam maker closed two kobo stronger at 3.92 naira.
"Insurance shares advanced because of improved perception of the state of health of financial institutions," a trader said.
Ahead of the pack was AIICO Insurance at 12.70 naira, a five kobo gain. Prestige Assurance rose three kobo to 5.15 naira, while Royal Exchange closed four kobo higher at 2.66 naira.
